# AT15-BRA-4-FO-B2-S25 · de Jong et al., Nature 2026 · gbmspace.org
# cell2location: BayraktarLab/GBM_space_paper · 2.1.run_cell2location.ipynb

import anndata as ad, pandas as pd, numpy as np
adata = ad.read_zarr("GBM-AT15-BRA-4-FO-B2-S25-anndata.zarr")
print(f"{adata.n_obs:,} tissue spots")

# 2.1.run_cell2location.ipynb — after export_posterior(..., use_quantiles=True)
c2l = ad.read_h5ad("sp_batchAT15.h5ad")
section = c2l[c2l.obs["sample_name"] == "AT15-BRA-4-FO-B2-S25"]
abund = pd.DataFrame(
    section.obsm["q05_cell_abundance_w_sf"],
    index=section.obs_names,
    columns=section.uns["mod"]["factor_names"],
)
dominant = abund.idxmax(axis=1)          # dominant state per spot
print(dominant.nunique(), "dominant cell2location states")

Gliosis-like                1862
CD8+ T cells                1436
NPC-neuronal-like 1          729
Exc L4-5 IT                  648
Oligodendrocytes 2           645
Neural-support astrocytes    637
dtype: int64

# Detection: fraction of spots with raw count > 0
# Official zarr: 18,199 genes; all 10,356 spots in_tissue=1
genes = ["GFAP", "VEGFA", "SOX2", "CD68", "EGFR", "OLIG2", "VWF", "MKI67"]
X = np.asarray(adata[:, genes].X)
pct = pd.Series((X > 0).mean(0) * 100, index=genes).round(1)
print(pct.to_string())

GFAP     78.0
VEGFA    62.1
SOX2     55.7
CD68     47.0
EGFR     45.6
OLIG2    41.9
VWF      40.6
MKI67    22.3

Gliosis-like is the top dominant state (1,862 spots, 18.0%); immune states (CD8+ T cells) dominate another 13.9% of spots; VEGFA detected in 62.1% and VWF in 40.6% of spots — consistent with the vascular-rich lower region of the H&E
